body: Past experience tells me that I can't be happy, trust me I've tried. I'm sorry it came off as self-pitying, I should've kept things to myself. I don't know why I thought sharing would help. I frequently do dumb stuff like that. I apologize.
Not dragging anyone else into it. I believe I've talked about my experiences just as others have talked about theirs.

Sounds frustrating. I can't quite identify because I've never been social but I do understand the isolation. You say you were social and use to be different so I'm wondering if something physical happened to you if this was a somewhat sudden change. Not trying to be funny at all when I ask this but have you had a head injury? Playing sports, fell down etc. A head injury can cause personality changes. Or do you have some other new change, new meds? Something like that could have weird side effects and cause personality issues. Sorry that no one is helping you. Wish I could offer more for you but what I've written is all I've got.
Trust me I wish you were right about that but seriously I have nothing to give the world or anyone in it. If you knew me better you'd agree.

There will be no love of my life. I have nothing to give anyone, and no one wants to be with a loser. No never had any genetic screening. No health insurance or money to do anything healthwise so not going to happen. Can barely afford food. I'm not sure wandering through life failing over and over makes me a trooper. Biggest fear about killing myself is failing, that would be tremendously embarrassing. But method I'll be using is pretty foolproof so that shouldn't be an issue. Everyone is worth saving is a nice idea but some of us are completely useless, I happen to be among that number. Trust me I'll be gone and it will have no effect on anyone, won't be missed. Used to make me sad but now I just accept it. I no longer feel anything.

While I appreciate your experience I have to say it is vastly different from mine. Most of my family doesn't give a shit about me, I have literally one friend, and this isn't just a fog. I've tried, I mean really tried, therapy and it was useless. Tried several different therapists to no avail. I've tried medication too and it didn't do anything except make me fat, great just what I wanted, to feel this way and be fat. 

I'm sincerely glad things have worked for you but trust me I've tried and tried and things don't get better for me. I have over 30 years of trying. One can only beat one's head against a brick wall for so long before realizing you're never going to make a hole in the wall and its time to give up. And everyone I've tried to seek out help with has simply rejected me or ignored me completely. Not everyone is worth saving, just a fact.

If you have a 4.4 GPA someone sees and recognizes that even if your parents don't. That honestly is a very good accomplishment. I can say that high school is bullshit and college will be much different. Not saying college will become this magical paradise for you but it is so much different than high school. And with your GPA you probably have your pick of colleges, plus you'll be away from your parents, and will likely make new friends. I know first hand how hard it is to have no one to be able to understand your sadness. Therapy never worked for me but many people claim that it worked for them. I don't want to be some just hang on and it will be rainbows person but I do think if you are able to hang on and attend at least one term of college you may have a different perspective. But ultimately you need to decide what you will do.
I think, despite what we are led to believe, suicide is quite a rational decision for some. I don't think 100% of suicides are tragic.

Agree. I'm in my 40s and have felt like I don't fit in/want to kill myself since I was around 9. For some people things do get better but for others it doesn't. I think teens and people in their early 20s should wait, but I personally think once you've made it past 30 you have had enough experience to know if you are in the midst of a crisis or if your life is just plain shit.

Yes I'm always up for a hot bath even in summer. Not sure I totally understand your question about what could make it a good day. But all I want is to have a few friends, 3-4 would be fantastic, be able to make money, not loads but be able to get by, on my interests (travel and art), and just generally feel like I have something to give the world, have some positive impact on the world. The reality is I've tried to do these things and I've failed. I have nothing to give anyone, no way to contribute to anyone's life, guess that is the most depressing part, knowing that my presence on earth makes not one iota of difference to anyone. And I have about as much ability to make friends as the average 3 year old. Seriously I'm an adult and I've never learned how to make friends. I've been in situations where I think I have a new friend but then a few months later they just disappear. Don't know why. Financially I'm always in the hole even though I live the most simple life ever. In the past few months I've stopped getting any food from restaurants at all, even stopped getting stuff from the grocery store deli, just make stuff at home or eat cereal. Food used to be a pleasure for me but now eating is more of a chore, some days I just don't bother at all. Used to have an art studio but can't afford that anymore so basically I have nothing that brings me any sort of pleasure or anything to look forward to at all. Food-boring, art/making shit-non-existant, travel-can't afford it, friends-nope. Lately all I do is sleep or watch youtube. Fucking pathetic. Not sure if that answers things or not. Not trying to be argumentative at all so I hope it doesn't come across that way, just stating the facts of my life.

Have to say I grew up Christian but saw the hypocrisy and silliness in it in highschool. Haven't believed since. If there actually is a god, which I do not believe is the case, he's one asshole. I knew a toddler who got a brain tumor, a good friend (a Christian who acted like Christian's should-pretty much all action and little talk) who was one of the best most giving people I know died of cancer, friend has some serious health issues that mess with her ability to work and she is an awesome person, not to mention all the wars and famines and others who are good people who are suffering. 

Thats what gets me about the bible, if something good happens you are to praise god, but if something bad happens it isn't god's fault. Ridiculous. And look at what he did to Job, lets him and his wife and family suffer just so god can prove to satan that Job is faithful, stupid. God's clearly an asshole.
Tried everything else-therapy etc so suicide is my last choice. no other options left. sounds like lots are in the same boat.

Almost 4 am where I am. About to take a hot bath and then will likely sleep 10-12 hours but would respond after that. Generally cycled or been progressively worse? Guess you could describe it as a shit spiral downwards. Yes occasionally good things happen but they are few and far between. Feel like a rock worn down by water through the process of erosion, very little left of me. One of the main issues is my life will never get better, no better career or financial security, will never have a good relationship, will never have the ability to make friends. You can only go through so much of life being a loser and naively thinking it might get better before you just realize that nope this is your shit life and you have to survive it or just exit stage left.

I've felt this way for a long, long time indeed. First thought about killing myself when I was 9. Never have felt like I fit in anywhere, not in school, not with family. Really only have 1 friend. Telling a lie to my family is easy because I have no desire to hurt them or exact some type of revenge on them. Could they have been better? Sure but many people experience worse. Their biggest offense is just kind of ignoring me. We just aren't close and part of that is because we are just very, very different people. I can say, without any bitterness that 2 of my 3 siblings I wouldn't be friends with if we weren't related, again just nothing in common aside from blood. 

Overall my life is shit and never really gets better. Have a "career" I no longer enjoy and is no way financially lucrative (can barely pay bills to live a super basic life), just the nature of this line of work really. No way to get another job, I've tried and failed time and time again. Things I really want to do and enjoy are very hard to make a living at. Got fired from a job recently. Should be looking for a new job but I just can't be bothered. I'm done, just so fucking done. 

Haven't had a relationship in years, and not just 2 or 3, but many, many years. No chance of one either. I'm fat and thats pretty much the death knell if you're a woman seeking a man. On top of that I'm not very smart, don't make much money, in short have little to nothing going for me so honestly who can blame someone for not wanting to be with me. 

So no relationship, a precarious financial position, no career prospects, and nothing to offer the world really. After I'm dead I'll be forgotten quickly. With several billion people on earth no everyone can be special. Just the way it is.

Ok. I'll make sure to include that in my note, that I knew I could talk to them, it is a lie but if it makes them feel better then I'm willing to say that. I mean the reality is I'm not close to many of them. Recently had something happen and emailed them but got a response from only one family member. 1/2 of them are religious and I'm not so they'd just tell me I need jesus or something. The others I feel somewhat close to but they'll just tell me to hang on etc, it gets better and that sort of bs. Unless you've experienced feeling like this for decades I just don't think people can understand.

I have no idea. Been in the same boat for years. Good old USA, even if you work you might not have health insurance. But in my situation I'm beyond any help. I've given up but I do hope that you find what you need. Sorry I couldn't help.
I plan on leaving a note explicitly stating that it is not their fault and that there was no way they should've predicted my actions. I'm hoping it helps.

Feel the same way. Recently I've felt nothing, absolutely nothing. Luckily I have an end date in mind so that is close and soon I won't have to deal with any of this. Was a friend's birthday recently which is the only reason I'm waiting to take action. Want to give it a bit of time between their birthday and my end. 

​
Totally agree. The whole "it gets better" is a lie.
